content_fixes.new: Honestly, your cocky attitude about all this is what's really getting to me. You're acting like it's no big deal, but it's a huge deal. Think about it: it only takes a tiny bit of yeast to make a whole batch of bread dough puff up. It's the same with this kind of bad vibe—it spreads like wildfire and infects the whole crew. So, you need to get rid of that toxic yeast before it ruins everything. Here's the real you: plain and true, not puffed up with garbage. The Messiah, our Passover Lamb, already gave everything for us, so let's keep it honest—no shady stuff, just truth. Now, I'm not saying you should ghost everyone outside the church who lives messy. You'd have to leave the planet for that. But when someone who calls themselves a Christian keeps living in sin—sleeping around, scamming people, dissing God, getting wasted, being greedy—don't just act like it's all good. Judging people outside the church isn't your job; God handles them. But inside the crew? Yeah, you need to deal with it. If someone's way out of line, clean house.
